newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israelis wound three Palestinians in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Israelis wound three Palestinians in Hebron.

text.p: Israeli soldiers shot and wounded three Palestinians, one seriously, during clashes on Friday with Arab stone-throwers in the West Bank flashpoint town of Hebron, witnesses said.
They said masked youths burned two Israeli flags and attacked troops stationed inside an Arab school where copies of the Moslem Koran were found torn up earlier this week.

Protesters, some using slingshots, hurled stones and fire bombs. Soldiers responded by firing rubber-coated metal bullets, wounding three youths, one in the head. Witnesses said medics rushed him to hospital in serious condition.
Hebron has been a scene of almost daily unrest since right-wing Jews plastered storefronts with anti-Moslem posters depicting the Moslem Prophet Mohammad as a pig two weeks ago.

Religous feelings were further inflamed when Palestinians found that Yaacoubia school was ransacked and four copies of the Koran torn up. Palestinians charged Israeli soldiers desecrated the holy books but the Israeli army denied the charge.

Israel handed over most of Hebron, home to more than 100,000 Palestinians, to the PLO in January under a self-rule deal but kept troops behind to guard some 400 Jewish settlers living or studying in the heart of the old city.

Israeli troops have ringed the city with checkpoints, turning back Palestinians from nearby villages. The siege, described by Israel as necessary for security, has further hurt the economy of the town which depends on trade with Palestinians outside Hebron.
